facts.text: The hotel is a converted 19th-century palace housed in an Isabeline-style building in the heart of Madrid.
facts.excerpt: This 19th-century palace, converted into a hotel, is housed in an Isabeline-style building in the very heart of Madrid.

facts.text: The hotel sits between Plaza de Oriente and Gran Via, in the Madrid de los Austrias district.
facts.excerpt: located in a 19th-century Isabeline palace between Plaza de Oriente and Gran Vía, in Madrid de los Austrias

facts.text: The hotel's design is inspired by the work of Velazquez.
facts.excerpt: This hotel, inspired by the work of Velázquez, is located in a 19th-century Isabeline palace

facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: Palacio de los Duques Gran Meliá - a member of The Leading Hotels of the World

facts.text: The hotel has historic gardens and rooftop views.
facts.excerpt: with its contemporary design, historic gardens, privileged rooftop views, and the fine local cuisine at its restaurant

facts.text: Jardin de los Duques restaurant is located in the palace's former stables and offers three distinct settings inspired by the Madrid of the Habsburgs.
facts.excerpt: Located in the former stables of the Palace, 300 metres from the Plaza de Oriente, this exclusive restaurant offers three distinct settings and gastronomic delights inspired by the Madrid of the Habsburgs.

facts.text: Jardin de los Duques has a main dining room, a private lounge and an outdoor area in the palace's historic garden.
facts.excerpt: A venue boasting a main dining room, a private lounge and an outdoor area in the historic garden of the Palacio de los Duques.

facts.text: Jardin de los Duques serves dishes inspired by Castilian tradition, combining sea and land flavors.
facts.excerpt: sea and land flavors and aromas come together in dishes inspired by Castilian tradition

facts.text: The private lounge at Jardin de los Duques hosts up to 20 guests.
facts.excerpt: Our private lounge, hosting up to 20 guests, offers the perfect setting for special events, business meetings or family celebrations.

facts.text: Los Duques Grand Cafe serves Mediterranean and international dishes with creative cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Discover dining options that combine history and modernity in Mediterranean and international dishes accompanied by creative cocktails.

facts.text: Thai Room Wellness offers Thai therapies in a setting with Burmese lacquers, Chinese antiques and Tibetan handicrafts.
facts.excerpt: Expert Thai therapies in a setting with Burmese lacquers, Chinese antiques and Tibetan handicrafts.

facts.text: The hotel lists a rooftop pool among its facilities.
facts.excerpt: - Rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel offers a complimentary Luxury Van service to take guests around the city of Madrid.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our complimentary "Luxury Van" service to take you wherever you want in the city of Madrid.

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, with a welcome gift for pets and natural and organic amenities.
facts.excerpt: exclusive pet-friendly hotel in Madrid. An atmosphere of distinction and hospitality where your pet will enjoy walks in public areas, a welcome gift and natural and organic amenities

facts.text: RedLevel guests get access to a private lounge with buffet and a la carte breakfast and an Open Bar service, plus a library and an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive access to the RedLevel Lounge, a lounge with buffet and à la carte breakfast and Open Bar service (please check hours)

facts.text: RedLevel guests have areas including an indoor lounge, a library and an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Relax in the different areas, including an indoor lounge area, a library, and an outdoor terrace.

facts.text: RedLevel services include butler service and late check-out until 14:00, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: concierge service, luggage and butler services, late check-out until 14:00 (subject to availability)

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a terrace with panoramic views of the Opera and the Barrio de los Austrias.
facts.excerpt: It provides a terrace with panoramic views of the Opera and the Barrio de los Austrias.

facts.text: The Velazquez Penthouse Suite has a terrace with views over the Madrid de los Austrias.
facts.excerpt: A fantastic penthouse with views over the Madrid de los Austrias from its amazing terrace

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms look onto a quiet private patio and have a bathroom with underfloor heating and a bathtub with a rainshower.
facts.excerpt: a bathroom with underfloor heating, a bathtub with a rainshower, and views of the quiet, private patio

facts.text: The hotel is about 0.55 km from the Royal Palace.
facts.excerpt: 0,55 km fromRoyal Palace

facts.text: The hotel is about 1.8 km from the Prado Museum.
facts.excerpt: 1,8 km fromPrado Museum

facts.text: The hotel arranges private access to a rehearsal of the Teatro Real orchestra or choir, a couple of minutes' walk away.
facts.excerpt: The Palacio de los Duques Gran Meliá is just a couple of minutes walk from the Teatro Real.

facts.text: The Teatro Real experience includes catering by chef Ramon Freixa and must be booked at least 48 hours in advance.
facts.excerpt: Reservations must be made at least 48 hours in advance. Depending on activity at the Teatro Real.

facts.text: A Capturing Madrid photo tour with a professional photographer starts in the hotel lobby and passes the Teatro Real, Sabatini Gardens, Plaza de Espana and the Temple of Debod.
facts.excerpt: Starting with the Teatro Real and continuing through the Sabatini Gardens, with its fountains and white marble sculptures, the recently renovated Plaza de España, and the spectacular Temple of Debod.

facts.text: A flamenco experience at Corral de la Moreria includes a private class, dinner and a flamenco show.
facts.excerpt: Private flamenco class with a professional flamenco dancer, Michelin star gastronomic experience, and flamenco show

facts.text: Check-in is at 15:00 and check-out at 12:00.
facts.excerpt: Check-in15:00

facts.text: The address is Cuesta de Santo Domingo 5 and 7, Madrid.
facts.excerpt: Cuesta de Santo Domingo 5 and 7

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a canvas by a Sevillian artist.
facts.excerpt: Palacio de los Duques is a canvas by a Sevillian artist, where his brushstrokes bring us closer to luxury, tradition, tranquility, and an authentic, traditional Madrid.
